zh-CN.status: source_fallback; official OVITO Chinese tutorial not confirmed

zh-CN: 当前为Three.js预览，尚未接入OVITO；不能把OVITO教程功能标为已支持。
结构和轨迹帧由ASE有界读取；以实际入口的格式/帧限制为准。
预览按所选帧的原子顺序绘制，图例显示各元素及计数，底栏显示原子总数。悬停或聚焦总数可查阅旋转与缩放手势，工具栏可重置视角。
en: The Three.js preview shows element-colored atoms in frame order, cell edges for a finite 3×3 cell, an element count legend, and the total atom count. Hover or focus the total for orbit and zoom instructions. Reset view restores the camera.

Worker ASE structure inspection accepts an explicit zero-based frame and bounds preview to 20000 atoms; actual registered ASE parser determines format support. RunDetail currently exposes preview only for xyz/traj file names; do not claim all ASE formats have a frontend entry.
No whole-trajectory animation, streaming index, OVITO pipeline or automatic scientific analysis is inferred from a visual preview.
OVITO official import and pipeline manuals are design references for a future integration; AIMatterLab does not ship those API capabilities.
